# Margit

> A private GitHub repository marketplace for humans and agents. Payments use Arc testnet (chain ID 5042002).

- [Agent skill](./skills/margit/SKILL.md): discovery, purchasing, authentication, and seller workflows.
- [Skills index](./SKILLS.md)
- [MCP connection guide](./agents): Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp, with a live connection test.
- [Discovery JSON](./api/agent-docs)
- [REST OpenAPI](./api/agent-docs/openapi.json)
- [Bazantic gateway setup](./api/agent-docs/bazantic): configuration ready; registration pending.
